learnings.title: Shopify UCP /buy permalink requires live discovery and legacy /cart compatibility
learnings.claim: Shopify's October 28, 2026 developer changelog states that UCP 2026-08-25 storefronts advertise dev.ucp.shopping.permalink at /.well-known/ucp, whose config.endpoint identifies the /buy route for variant quantity, discount and checkout links. Legacy /cart remains supported and is still required for selling plans, line-item properties, cart notes and cart attributes; /buy links must be built from the discovered endpoint. This documentation does not establish that this workspace's store is public, supports UCP, or has clickable links in YouTube Shorts descriptions.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_UCP_BUY_LINK_DISCOVERY_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. Before using /buy for video_shopify conversions, verify that the actual store is public and UCP-capable, read /.well-known/ucp and its dev.ucp.shopping.permalink config.endpoint, then validate real variant IDs and a permitted checkout test. Keep /cart for selling plans, line-item properties, cart notes and cart attributes. Never put buyer personal details, payment credentials or tokens in a public link; do not assume Shorts description URLs are clickable. If store is private or UCP unsupported, mark N/A. No automatic checkout, store write or publish. Record applied_learning_ids only in a real source-linked decision/manifest with artifact SHA.
learnings.next_measurement: Read-only verify whether the actual Shopify store advertises dev.ucp.shopping.permalink and a valid config.endpoint, and whether a permitted Shorts traffic surface has a clickable destination. Record found/not-found, actual manifest SHA and source-linked application only if used.
fallback_history: If UCP discovery is missing or the store remains private, retain legacy /cart documentation for later review and do not construct /buy links by guesswork or claim conversion readiness.
